summary: The lamp button only works sometimes because the code uses long delay() calls in the main loop, blocking button reads for two seconds at a time.

causes.title: Loop execution is blocked by delay() calls
causes.why: The runtime trace shows that one pass of loop() takes 2.00 seconds due to delay(1000) calls: 'NST|t_ms=2058|loop_slowest_us=2000060|loops=1'.
causes.check: Try holding the button down continuously for more than 2 seconds until it finally responds.
causes.fix: Replace delay() with non-blocking timing using millis() so the button is checked frequently.

rule_findings.title: One pass of loop() took 2.00 s
rule_findings.evidence: Anything that must react quickly (buttons, sensors, motors) waits this long.
rule_findings.fix: Look for delay() or blocking calls in loop(); use millis() timing instead.
